objective: Qualify a power-of-two-scaled reciprocal correction for the observed layer2 key normalization error, then test it at one additional site in the separate06f group0.

proposal.domain: positive finite FP32 denominators [4,64], seed within one adjacent FP32 value of nearest-even 1/d
proposal.mapping: d_scaled = d * 0.125; seed_scaled = seed * 8; corrected = existing_helper(d_scaled, seed_scaled) * 0.125
proposal.rationale: Power-of-two scaling maps [4,64] to the already-tested [.5,8] domain. Exactness, neighbor mapping, boundary behavior and native execution still require their own gates. Do not expand the original helper contract by assertion.
proposal.fallback: Outside the separately tested domain retain the original reciprocal; validate safe guarded evaluation before adoption.

constraints: Preserve original and promoted qualified CPU cohorts/runtime and unchanged full-model thresholds.
Preserve first06f correction in the separate baseline. Modify only the identified second reciprocal and its guarded wrapper.
Do not correct earlier sites merely because their intermediate reciprocal differs; their warm quantized outputs are exact.
No full-model expansion before local correction and CPU-preservation gates pass.

gates.requirement: Freeze scaled arithmetic/design and directed inputs. Verify exact power-of-two scaling and seed-neighbor mapping for both original boundary cases and captured cold/warm CPU/GPU key denominators/seeds.

Host scaled helper must match exact rational nearest-even FP32 reference and preserve all correct CPU reciprocal bytes on captured, directed power-boundary and frozen random cases. Include [4,64] guard boundaries and out-of-domain fallback checks.

Native supplied-seed component in actual rank4 [1,Q,2,1] shape must match oracle under both policies and preserve CPU controls. Keep standalone seed reproduction separate; failure to reproduce alone cannot establish or refute an in-model repair.

Separate one-additional-site model candidate must preserve all unrelated operations, weights and interfaces; reproduce original erroneous seed and same-policy endpoints/states. Require all CPU endpoints and eight states exact; taps must preserve candidate endpoints/states. Verify corrected reciprocal and key-normalized output, then measure K2 cache and downstream output/state residuals on the same two fixtures.

Independent raw-array audit, qualified CPU cohort preservation, reports/log/decision update and checksum seal. Keep cold attention discrepancy and any remaining drift open; full numerical/lifecycle/partition/boundary/generation gates precede GPU adoption.
